race.comment: THE EXTREME CAT (5) gets the nod with the inside draw, a proven record at this track and distance, and enough excuses in his recent runs to expect a stronger showing. CONTEMPORARY (1) is the clear danger on consistency, having placed at Rocky last start after jumping awkwardly, and his record at this track and around 1200m is very solid. Just has to carry the weight. RAETIHI (2) is chasing a third straight win after scoring at this venue and at Cloncurry. Going too good to ignore. COCHRANE (4) was only just over a length from RAETIHI last time and had won at Cloncurry the run prior. Gets in well at the weights and will take some reeling in for his rivals if he gets a soft time of it in front.
